messages.subject: Passing Rlist as a parameter to function in R
messages.subject_clean: Passing Rlist as a parameter to function in R
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I have multiple Rscripts which are to be run in pipeline one after the
other.
What I want to know is that my first script ouputs a dataframe which I
store it as Rlist in java.

I want to use this Rlist as an input to another Rscript which basically
expects a dataframe as an input.

Can you please suggest how can I use Rlist to pass it as a parameter to a
function in R which expects a dataframe as an input.

Regards,
Suraj Sharma

messages.subject_clean: Getting R plots back to the Client
messages.body_plain:
Note that even without enabled I/O you can use something like

byte x[] = c.eval("readBin('filename',raw(),file.info('filename')$size)").asBytes();

The difference between using I/O and the above is that the above results in one message whereas I/O uses multiple messages to send the payload in chunks (i.e., has lower memory footprint for large files).

Cheers,
Simon
